subject.title: fix(telegram): send typing cue from isolated ingress worker

question: Should isolated Telegram ingress be allowed to expose a typing acknowledgement before the sender has passed the normal DM authorization checks?
rationale: Preserving the earliest possible cue conflicts with the established rule that unauthorized DM activity is dropped before user-visible or stateful handling; choosing where that acknowledgement may occur is a channel security and product-boundary decision.

options.title: Authorize before typing
options.body: Pass a canonical authorization result or safe authorization snapshot to the worker and emit typing only for senders already permitted by the effective DM policy.

options.title: Move typing after authorization
options.body: Keep authorization in the main Telegram inbound pipeline and accept a later cue rather than duplicating policy inside the worker.

options.title: Permit pre-auth acknowledgement
options.body: Explicitly accept that any structurally valid private-message sender may trigger a best-effort typing action before rejection, with documented abuse and privacy tradeoffs.

recommendation.title: Authorize before typing
recommendation.body: Pass a canonical authorization result or safe authorization snapshot to the worker and emit typing only for senders already permitted by the effective DM policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on unauthorized Telegram DM handling and generic ingress most directly overlaps this decision.
